purpose: Measured model observations for game difficulty review. Not human solve-time calibration and not an AtCoder rating.

modelCondition.provenance: Model/effort are the orchestration request, not independently returned API telemetry. No instant measurement is claimed.
modelCondition.unspecifiedParameters: Provider/session defaults; temperature, seed, sampling internals and output-token telemetry were not exposed or recorded.

finalCohort.instructionTemplate: Blind C++20 benchmark. Read ONLY /workspace/code-typer-idle/work/compound-blind-{task}.json; it contains the complete player-visible problem. No other file reads, internet, code execution, references, or communication. First action functions.exec: const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:'cat /workspace/code-typer-idle/work/compound-blind-{task}.json',max_output_tokens:5000});text(r.output);const t=await tools.clock__curr_time({});store('{task}_final{trial}_start',t.current_time);text(t.current_time); Then solve independently. Second functions.exec: define answer as a String.raw C++ literal, read tools.clock__curr_time({}), create record {id:'challenge/v1/cpp/systems/{id}',trial:'final{trial}',startedAt:load('{task}_final{trial}_start'),endedAt:t.current_time,answer}, store('{task}_final{trial}_record',record), text(record). Do not run solution or use any other tools. Final response copies the actual returned JSON, not tool-call source. Return C++ function + includes, no main.
withheld: private test inputs and expected outputs
finalCohort.recordPersistence: After the answer-generating timed turn, a separate follow-up copied the stored record to JSON. File persistence and production grading are outside the model clock interval.

initialCohort.problemDelivery: Problem JSON was supplied inline rather than read from the final prompt file. The exact common instruction was not retained.
initialCohort.statementRevision: The route prompt preceded the explicit no-cap-after-supply clarification; its original private test suite had 17 cases. All initial answers below were regraded, without code repair, against the final 20 delivery / 18 route cases.
initialCohort.pooling: Exploratory observations only. Keep separate from final-statement trials and from the earlier v2.5.0 six-problem baseline.

clock.finalStart: Clock read in the first tool call after the player JSON was read. The problem-file read is outside the clock interval.
clock.finalEnd: Clock read after the C++ answer had been generated as a String.raw argument in the second tool call.
includes: reasoning and answer generation between those tool calls
tool/inference scheduling and clock-call overhead inside that interval
excludes: initial agent startup before the first clock read
clock.interpretation: A coarse tool-clock span, not pure inference latency, not separately measured reasoning time, and not human minutes.

grading.engine: Unmodified production browser QuizRunner; syntax Quiz uses unmodified production gradeSkillQuiz.
grading.compilerAndRuntimeTimes: Recorded separately in loadMilliseconds / compileAndTestMilliseconds. They are not counted as model answer-generation time.
grading.caseFailureRule: A submission clears only if all cases pass and no compile/runtime error occurs. A compile error is a failed submission; null actual values in its case rows are not independently executed wrong answers.

snapshot.title: 受付時刻と積載を守る集荷・配達
snapshot.description: 荷物数nはweightsの長さです。時刻0に空荷で拠点0を出発し、荷物iの集荷点i+1と配達点n+i+1をそれぞれ1回ずつ訪れ、全荷物を配達して拠点0へ戻る最早時刻を返してください。荷物iは集荷後にだけ配達でき、集荷から配達までweights[i]の積載を使います。積載重量の合計は常にcapacity以下とします。各作業地点pではappointmentsの3*(p-1)から[受付開始,受付終了,作業時間]を読みます。到着後は任意に待機でき、受付開始以上かつ受付終了以下の時刻に作業を開始し、作業時間が経過してから出発します。作業終了が受付終了を超えることは許されます。移動はtravel[from*(2*n+1)+to]だけかかります。追加の中継訪問や途中の拠点帰還はできません。全配達を終えた後は最後の配達点から拠点へ直接戻ります。実行可能な順序がなければ-1、荷物が0個なら0を返します。 実装方法は自由です。
constraints: 添字は0始まりです。数値の各要素と途中計算は符号付き32bit整数の範囲内です。
nは0〜6。weightsの各値は1〜9、capacityは0〜20です。
travelの長さは(2*n+1)^2。行が出発点、列が到着点で、各移動時間は0〜40、対角成分は0です。非対称でもよく、三角不等式は保証しません。
appointmentsの長さは6*n。各受付時刻は0〜300で、0<=受付開始<=受付終了<=300。各作業時間は0〜10です。
n=0ではtravel=[0]、appointments=[]。地点番号・添字・時刻はすべて整数で、添字は0始まりです。

parameters.name: weights
parameters.description: 荷物iの重量。長さnが荷物数です。

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: 同時に積める重量の上限。

parameters.name: travel
parameters.description: 地点0から2*nまでの直接移動時間を行優先に並べた行列。

parameters.name: appointments
parameters.description: 作業地点1から2*nまでの[受付開始,受付終了,作業時間]を順に連結した列。

examples.explanation: 集荷点へ時刻1に着いて5まで待機し、作業は5〜7。配達点は8〜11に作業します。受付終了は作業開始の期限なので、拠点に戻る時刻12まで実行できます。
両方を集荷してから配達すると積載上限を超えます。片方を配達してから残りを集荷すると、もう一方の受付期限2に間に合いません。

snapshot.title: 消耗鍵と時刻ゲートの巡回経路
snapshot.description: 時刻0にstartから出発し、goalへ最も早く到着する時刻を返す。到達不能なら-1。各辺は一方通行で、地点への再訪と任意の待機ができる。 suppliesは[地点,鍵の種類,個数]の繰り返し。到着時（出発地点を含む）に、その地点の未取得レコードをすべて自動取得する。各レコードから得られるのは全経路を通じて一度だけ。 doorsは[必要な鍵の種類,解錠作業時間]の繰り返し。鍵の種類は0と1。 edgesは[from,to,移動時間,周期,開く位相,扉ID]の繰り返し。扉ID=-1なら扉なし。同じ扉IDは異なる辺でも解錠状態を共有する。 閉じた扉の辺を初めて通るときは、必要な種類の鍵1個を消費して解錠作業を行う。鍵がなければ通れない。扉は以後ずっと開き、再通過で鍵や解錠時間は不要。 その後、時刻を周期で割った余りが開く位相になるまで待ってから移動する。扉なし・解錠済みの辺も同じ時刻条件に従う。鍵消費→解錠作業→時刻待ち→移動→到着地点で補給、の順序。start=goalなら0。実装方法は自由。 実装方法は自由です。
constraints: 添字は0始まりです。数値の各要素と途中計算は符号付き32bit整数の範囲内です。
nodesは1〜24。startとgoal、辺の両端、補給の地点は0以上nodes未満。
edgesは最大144辺、長さは6の倍数。移動時間は0〜20、周期は1〜7、開く位相は0以上周期未満。平行辺と自己ループも許す。
initialKeysは種類0・種類1の初期個数をこの順に持つ長さ2の列で、各個数は0〜2。
suppliesは最大4件、長さは3の倍数。鍵の種類は0か1、個数は1か2。同じ地点に複数レコードがあってよい。
doorsは最大4扉、長さは2の倍数。必要な鍵の種類は0か1、解錠作業時間は0〜5。辺の扉IDは-1か有効な扉の添字。
すべて整数。時刻待ちや解錠中に別の辺を通ることはできない。扉と補給の状態は1本の経路の中でのみ共有する。

observations: On the final player statements, delivery has 1/3 first-attempt clears with coarse intervals 5,6,5 seconds (median 5). Route has 3/3 clears with intervals 12,15,14 seconds (median 14).
The shorter model clock interval did not imply the higher first-attempt success rate: the delivery solutions contained acceptance-deadline and carried-load mistakes.
A single initial route submission failed to compile because its raw C++ omitted <map>. It remains a compile-error; no include was inserted to manufacture a pass.

These observations justify recording correctness and elapsed intervals separately. They do not identify a calibrated numeric difficulty level, a human completion time, or an objective reward multiplier.

diagnosedFailures.detail: The first-pickup initialization compares max(0,opening) to the closing time, omitting travel from the depot. It admits a pickup reached after its closing time; expected -1, actual 3.
The precomputed load adds visited pickup weights but never subtracts completed deliveries. It incorrectly rejects feasible routes that unload before the next pickup.

std::map is used without including <map>. Production compiler rejects the unedited code. Static inspection also finds min(2, keys + count), imposing a post-supply key cap absent from the final statement. That semantic issue was not executed, and this earlier-statement sample is not pooled with final wrong-answer trials.

limitations: Only two hand-selected compound C++ problems and three final first attempts per problem; this is not a catalog-wide sample or a stable empirical difficulty estimate.
All final attempts use one model and one reasoning setting. Shared model priors, known algorithm patterns and correlated behavior limit interpretation of repeated fresh contexts.
Output code lengths differ. The clock cannot separate reasoning from code generation, tool overhead or transient service load.
The primary clock medians include all first attempts, including wrong answers. They are not time-to-correct; no repair loop was measured. Accepted-only clock fields are provided separately.
One-second clock precision is coarse relative to the observed durations; small timing differences should not be ranked confidently.
The initial pilot uses different prompt delivery and an earlier route statement. The historical v2.5.0 pilot uses different tasks/protocol. Neither is pooled with final trials.

No human minute or AtCoder-rating conversion is performed. authoredDifficulty and authoredEstimatedMinutes in grading rows are catalog context, withheld from the solvers, not derived from measured seconds.
Regrading below is reproducible from recorded raw answers and the matching build. Model generation itself has no provided replay command, exposed seed or exact instant setting.

historicalBaseline.scope: Six previous C++ tasks, two fresh first attempts each. Different problems and protocol; historical context only.

requestedAndConfiguredMode.executedMode: reasoning_effort=low (instant is not selectable in this environment)

historicalBaseline.extractionDiagnostic: One max-subarray trial returned unexecuted timer-call source. Its String.raw C++ was extracted verbatim for diagnostic grading, but its timing is invalid. It is not a fully valid timed-model response.
